issues.reason: Nothing licenses an entity-attached temporal / framing 'in' — entity-attached surface prepositions cover position (non-containment) and origin, containment in a place is LocatedIn, and Time mandates that a copular clause with a time modifier reifies the state to anchor it ('Alice was ill on Friday') — so the frame belongs on the reified active state, which is also what the framing-PP form (In <what-is-claimed> ...) says.

Core patterns forbids silently dropping a stated restriction because omitting it widens the claim, and as emitted (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (Member $x active)) makes every member active without qualification — the In atom on the group symbol never reaches the predication.

new_gaps: a frame- or time-modified copular predication over a PLURAL group: the state-reification trigger and the bar on predicating a member state of the group symbol collide, and the only precedent for a per-member reified state (a Skolem-function state in the rule's conclusion) is an aside in Resultatives

a period-denoting definite NP ('the present generation') has no Time-family carrier — Time terms are calendar terms or deictic constants and During is lexically restricted to during/while/throughout — so such a frame can only ride the preposition-named oblique
defect_summary: Both confirmed issues share one compliant form: reify the state per member inside the distribution rule and carry the frame there — (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (And (Member (sk_active $x) active) (Experiencer (sk_active $x) $x) (In (sk_active $x) sk_generation_1) (Member $x active))) (STV 1.0 0.9) — keeping the group, its Cardinality 43 and the generation's typing atoms at top level and dropping (In sk_group_1 sk_generation_1).
notes: The count, the group witness, the refusal to put (Member sk_group_1 active) on the group symbol, and In as the head are all right; only the frame's anchor, and hence the rule's unrestricted conclusion, is wrong.
